note: Family-owned campground on the Cedar River ~1 mile east of Vinton, operating since 1966. Grass sites, some pull-through; portable restrooms; private boat ramp; carry-in/carry-out trash; gate closes at night. No ATVs, UTVs, motorcycles or golf carts. --Claude
summary: New rate $25, 50 amp and dump added; water, season, phone-only booking confirmed. Pin ~1 km wrong; waterfront lead riverview. Passes gate.
flags: PIN WRONG: stored 42.16550,-92.00450 sits about 1.05 km WEST of the campground, on the east edge of Vinton beside a creek bottom. Campground is the grass field with gravel spurs and a drive at about 42.1627,-91.9924 (site row) and 42.1633,-91.9930 (field), reached from 2575 59th St Dr. Google's 42.1608729,-91.9941555 is the owner's house about 240 m SW. Imagery of the correct spot: Esri at z18, winter leaf-off, loops and pads can be seen. Any stored waterfront_evidence read at the old pin is not evidence.

WATERFRONT LEAD: stored 'not waterfront' contradicts the operator: 'a great view of the river', 'right on the Cedar River'; RV Life 7/2025: 'Quiet with River views', 'Excellent Riverside park'. Imagery at the right pin: the field's north edge runs along the Cedar (~120 m wide there, so river, not creek), but a gravel drive runs the length of the bank between the field and the water, with a thin line of trees. So riverfront fails on the road; riverview fits, with the view filtered through that line. Gallery shows RVs on open grass and bank shots of the river, not a view from a site I can tie down, so the imagery carries it. Upgrade 'not waterfront' -> riverview is the lead; I saw no basis for higher. The back row of gravel spurs (~42.1627,-91.9924) is ~130 m from the water.

GATE FACTS: $25 posted, electric and water, 20/30/50 amp. GS: none stored. Gateway: none within 40 km (nearest family home 230 km). Presence: working own site with phone (319) 241-1410, Matt Dulin; Google open. RATINGS: Google 4.8 (28); RV Life 4.5 stars, tier 2, 2 reviews read ($22 and $25, 7/2025, fifth wheel and travel trailer, both pull-through). Passes. LONG-STAY: nothing on the pages about monthly or seasonal sites; gallery is rally groups. No concern. Page copyright reads 2023, rate is undated; the 2025 camper reports back it.
FLUSH TOILETS/SHOWERS: operator says 'Clean Portable Restrooms'; no showers mentioned. Not written as false (silence on showers), kept in note.
